claude.performance_metric: AMS segment retained, no divestiture/goodwill impairment; AMS net sales grew $280.6M (2016) to $433.2M (2017), 2017 operating profit $48.5M
claude.rationale: The slice documents a coherent product/process outcome: the acquired resin-based business was folded into an expanding AMS segment, Conwed's netting assets were aligned to existing netting production ("footprint rationalization") and the acquired companies were "integrated into a more holistically aligned operating segment," so no realized product/process incoherence is documented (p4=0). At the process/organization interface the registrant reports re-branding and a transition toward a "more unified" AMS sales organization along with routine severance/restructuring, but no documented fracture or breakdown of operations against people/culture, so p5=0. No archetype incoherence (t1) or irreconcilable business-model conflict (t2) is documented; the acquired business was retained with no impairment or divestiture in the window.

grok.performance_metric: no divestiture; no goodwill impairment; assets retained
grok.rationale: The slice documents no product/process incoherence: annual goodwill tests in 2016 and 2017 showed no impairment, the acquired resin-based businesses were retained within AMS, and Conwed was described as presenting synergy opportunities via footprint rationalization with existing netting assets and as integrated into a more holistically aligned operating segment. At the process/organization interface, the slice records only planned integration steps—re-branding acquired companies, transitioning AMS sales toward a more unified organization, plus routine equipment impairment and severance from downsizing—without any documented fracture of operations against people/management/culture. Absence of realized disruption evidence codes both pathways 0.
